platform_mcp_taobao_fenxiao_alimama_app_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_FENXIAO_ALIMAMA_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_taobao_fenxiao_alimama_app_.description: AppKey of your Taobao Open Platform (TOP) application (open.taobao.com console).

platform_mcp_taobao_fenxiao_alimama_app_.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_FENXIAO_ALIMAMA_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_taobao_fenxiao_alimama_app_.description: AppSecret of the same application; signs every call as upper-case MD5(secret + parameters sorted by name as name+value + secret) and is never sent.

platform_mcp_taobao_fenxiao_alimama_adzo.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TAOBAO_FENXIAO_ALIMAMA_ADZONE_ID
platform_mcp_taobao_fenxiao_alimama_adzo.description: Promotion slot id: the last number of your 淘宝联盟 PID mm_xxx_xxx_<adzone_id> (pub.alimama.com > 推广管理 > 推广位管理).

tools.name: me
tools.description: taobao.time.get: Taobao server time; a signed call that verifies the app_key/app_secret pair.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: 淘宝联盟 taobao.tbk.dg.material.optional.upgrade (物料搜索升级版): keyword (`query`) or category (`category`, comma-separated backend cids) search of promotable Taobao/Tmall items for your adzone; price = current selling price (zk_final_price), final_price = estimated price after coupons, url = your promotion click_url, income_rate = commission + subsidy %. `id` is the new-style 淘宝客 item id.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: 淘宝联盟 taobao.tbk.item.info.get (简版): one item's title, list price (reserve_price), selling price (zk_final_price), images, shop, 30-day sales and location.
